entries.dialogueText: "A complete victory is in sight, Your Majesty."

entries.dialogueText: "Then be the wall that protects the mainland. Do not let them pass under any condition."

entries.dialogueText: "I knew that our cause was just. We will take back what is rightfully ours."

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty."

entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Unfortunately, we won't be able to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, we won't be able to gain any new territory at this point. Our hands are tied, Your Majesty."

entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty... if we push harder and fail, we'll find ourselves in an even more precarious situation."

entries.dialogueText: "Respectfully, General, I disagree. I order you to attack."

entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, Your Majesty."

entries.dialogueText: "We won't win this war without information. Which brings me to the following."

entries.dialogueText: "We need to talk about enemy positions."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "Their ground forces have been replenished and stand ready for our attack."

entries.dialogueText: "As for their navy, they seem to have pulled back to blockade the seas neighboring the Palesian capital."

entries.dialogueText: "It'll be harder to get the upper hand on them this time."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "But we still have the upper hand."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "Nonetheless, I advise caution."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "As for their navy... our intelligence units are having a hard time divulging their whereabouts."

entries.dialogueText: "As for their navy, they seemed to have pulled back north to blockade the seas neighboring Fort Ales."

entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Lespia is another matter.""
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia is another matter."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Thankfully, Pales doesn't seem to..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "Lespia has decided to provide at least some manpower and equipment assistance to Pales."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Including their newest bombs and b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Including their newest bombs and bomber jets."

entries.dialogueText: "Those goddamn meddlers again... Someday it will be their turn as well."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "Ha. Those meddlers are too scared of Rizia's might to attempt anything."

entries.dialogueText: "There is still much to discuss about our plans. But this overview should suffice for now."

entries.dialogueText: "Do you have any questions, Your Majesty?"

entries.dialogueText: "Their navy is currently blockading our ports in the southern seas."

entries.dialogueText: "However, our coastal artillery is effectively keeping their landing crafts at bay. With the defenses we have in place, we do not anticipate a naval invasion."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "Lespia may be the deciding factor here."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "They do not seem to have sent any substantial support to Pales yet."

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, but if the tides change, they very well might."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "Let's hope the wind is at our back. That concludes today's overview."

entries.dialogueText: "Do you have any questions for us, Your Majesty?"

entries.dialogueText: "Was this all a mistake?"

entries.dialogueText: She pointed at Lespia on the map.
